mapper.insert:
insert into CBONDPRICES (OBJECT_ID, S_INFO_WINDCODE, TRADE_DT, B_DQ_OPEN, B_DQ_HIGH, B_DQ_LOW, B_DQ_ORIGINCLOSE, B_DQ_VOLUME, B_DQ_AMOUNT,OPDATE,OPMODE) values
(#{item.objectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.sInfoWindcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.tradeDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.bDqOpen,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bDqHigh,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bDqLow,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bDqOriginclose,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bDqVolume,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.bDqAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.opdate,jdbcType=DATE},#{item.opmode,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select A.OBJECT_ID, A.S_INFO_WINDCODE, date_format(STR_TO_DATE(A.TRADE_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DT, A.B_DQ_OPEN, A.B_DQ_HIGH, A.B_DQ_LOW, A.B_DQ_ORIGINCLOSE, A.B_DQ_VOLUME, ifnull(A.B_DQ_AMOUNT*1000,NULL) B_DQ_AMOUNT, A.OPDATE,A.OPMODE from CBONDPRICES A WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT B WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE='F01' AND A.S_INFO_WINDCODE = B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID ) AND A.TRADE_DT = #{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
